description: Free-floating terminals on an infinite canvas, inspired by Apple Freeform: drag, resize and see all your terminals at once.
config.defaultWidth: Width (px at 100% zoom) of a new terminal.
config.defaultHeight: Height (px at 100% zoom) of a new terminal.
config.restoreLayout: When reopening Terminal Fly, recreate the terminals at their saved positions (with new shells).
config.wheelBehavior: What the mouse scroll wheel does on the canvas background. Over a terminal it always scrolls the terminal, and ⌘/Ctrl + scroll always zooms.
config.wheelBehavior.zoom: Scrolling zooms in and out (Shift + scroll still moves the canvas).
